notes: Variant WLC.JOS.6.5.v001 is underdetermined over s009-s011 and the fallback is ASV-compatible; no textual decision is made here (rule 9).

The frame's *that* (t005) stays with s002: the apodosis (יָרִיעוּ כָל־הָעָם) writes no waw of its own, so rule 45's apodosis-waw case does not arise; s022 opens the later consequence clause and keeps only its *and*.
t016 *and* is `added` — no conjunction morpheme stands before the כְּ clause (rule 14).

s028's suffix is `unrepresented` beside *flat*; the competing reading fuses s027-s028 under rule 30 on the ground that *flat* renders the whole *in its place*. The chapter reads JOS.6.20 the same way, so the two verses are consistent.
